ProgramName: Master of Arts in Master of Arts
Requirements: Transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate institutions attended; Letters of Recommendation (the number required varies by program); A Statement of Academic Purpose (required for all programs); Test Scores (GRE, English Language Tests, etc.); Writing Sample (if required by your program); Résumé/CV (if required by your program); Application Fee
Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science
Description: The Graduate School of Arts and Science (GSAS) offers more than 50 Master's programs, including the MA, MS, and MFA degrees. Most of these programs are designed for students who are preparing for doctoral study, but some are also designed to prepare students for specific careers or to enhance their professional credentials. GSAS also offers more than 10 dual-degree programs in collaboration with other NYU schools. The majority of these are master's programs.

ProgramName: Master of Science in Master of Science
Requirements:
The online application form, along with the application fee, is typically the first step. You will then be asked to upload or submit additional materials as outlined below. Always refer to your desired program's page for specific details, as requirements may vary.

Transcripts: Unofficial transcripts from each college or university where you have earned a degree, or from which you have received credit for courses that you wish to have count toward your graduate degree at NYU, are required for the application process. Official transcripts will be required upon admission.

Letters of Recommendation: Most departments require three letters of recommendation from faculty or others qualified to evaluate your academic and professional abilities. Please consult the specific program to which you are applying for further details on the number of letters and the type of information that is expected. Recommenders upload their letters directly to the online application system.

Statement of Academic Purpose: This required statement should be a concise essay of approximately 500 words (or two pages double-spaced) that describes your primary academic and research interests, your experiences, and your objectives.

Resume/Curriculum Vitae: Required for all applicants.

Test Scores:
GRE General Test: Many departments require the Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) General Test. Some departments require a GRE Subject Test. For master's programs in the sciences and social sciences, the GRE General Test may be optional or required. Please check your desired program's page for specifics.
English Language Proficiency Test: All applicants are required to demonstrate proficiency in English to be considered for admission. Proficiency can be demonstrated in one of the following ways: TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo, or PTE Academic, or by meeting exemption criteria.

Writing Sample: Required only by specific programs. Please consult the specific program to which you are applying for further details.
Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science

ProgramName: Master of Business Administration in Master of Business Administration
Requirements: The application process for the Full-time MBA program at NYU Stern requires an online application, essays (two short essays and one professional aspirations essay), a resume, academic transcripts from all prior institutions (self-reported initially), GMAT/GRE/Executive Assessment (EA) scores (waivers may be available for eligible candidates), two letters of recommendation (at least one from a current or former supervisor), a video essay, and an application fee ($250, fee waivers available for some applicants). Applicants whose native language is not English and who have not completed their undergraduate or graduate degree in an institution where the sole language of instruction is English must also demonstrate English Language Proficiency (TOEFL or IELTS required).
Concentration: Accounting, Asset Management, Business Analytics, Corporate Finance, Digital Marketing, Entrepreneurship & Innovation, FinTech, Global Business, Healthcare, Leadership & Change Management, Luxury Marketing, Management of Technology and Operations, Marketing, Product Management, Quantitative Finance, Real Estate, Social Innovation & Impact, Strategy, Supply Chain Management, Sustainable Business & Innovation
Description: The NYU Stern Full-time MBA Program prepares students for transformational careers. Our curriculum combines strong academic fundamentals with flexible options to customize your MBA, allowing students to align their studies with their professional goals and interests. Experience a rich student life in the heart of NYC, leverage our robust alumni network, and benefit from career resources that will set you up for success.
Accredidation: NYU Stern School of Business is accredited by AACSB International (The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business).

Requirements: Upload all of the following in the application portal: Statement of Purpose (500 words or less), Resume/CV, Two (2) Letters of Recommendation, Academic Transcripts, Portfolio (see below for specific requirements), GRE is not required, English Language Proficiency (if applicable). All applicants must apply online through the NYU Graduate School of Arts and Science (GSAS) website.
Description: The Interactive Telecommunications Program (ITP) is a two-year graduate program that explores the imaginative use of communications technologies and their capacity to affect culture and society. Our mission is to explore and develop the expressive possibilities of new and emerging media, with a focus on interactivity, computation, and community. We are a center for the design and study of new media, for example: creating interactive installations, augmented reality and virtual reality applications, computational art and music, immersive experiences, and much more. ITP is part of the Tisch School of the Arts at NYU.

Requirements:
Online Application
You will submit the online application where you will upload the following:
*   Resume: Upload your most current professional resume, including your work history, education, volunteer work, and extracurricular activities.
*   Essays: Answer the essay questions provided in the online application. We learn more about your unique personality, professional goals, and decision-making skills through these essays.
*   Letters of Recommendation: You will be required to submit two letters of recommendation. One letter must be from a current or previous supervisor. The second letter may be from an additional supervisor, or someone who can speak to your professional strengths, such as a client or a professor.
*   Transcripts: Upload unofficial transcripts from all colleges and universities you have attended in the education section of the online application. If admitted, official transcripts from all degree-granting institutions will be required.
*   Standardized Tests (GMAT/GRE): The GMAT or GRE is required for all applicants. An official GMAT or GRE score report is required by the application deadline. Please have your official scores sent to NYU Stern using the following codes: GMAT (ZT2-R0-38) and GRE (2582). Stern does not have a minimum score requirement. Waiver for CPA-Eligible Applicants: Applicants who have passed all four sections of the CPA exam may be eligible for a GMAT/GRE waiver. More information regarding the waiver and eligibility criteria is available in the online application.
*   Application Fee: A $120 non-refundable application fee is required and must be paid online via credit card. Waivers are available in specific circumstances, including U.S. military personnel and members of certain organizations.
Department: Leonard N. Stern School of Business
Description: The NYU Stern Master of Science in Accounting (MS in Accounting) program is designed for students who want to become licensed certified public accountants (CPAs). Students will develop a deep understanding of the global financial reporting environment, tax, audit, and financial advisory. The program is registered as a 150-hour CPA-eligible program and provides graduates with the necessary credits to meet the educational requirements for CPA licensure in New York State and most other states. The MS in Accounting curriculum prepares students for careers in public accounting, corporate finance, and consulting, among other fields. Students acquire the analytical, critical thinking, and communication skills necessary to succeed in a dynamic business environment. A 12-month full-time curriculum is offered to both recent college graduates and those with limited work experience.

Requirements: Complete and submit the online application. Pay the non-refundable application fee. Unofficial transcripts are required for the application review process. Official transcripts are required upon admission. English language proficiency is required for international students whose native language is not English. Strong applicants typically have two or more years of full-time, relevant professional experience.
Department: Robert F. Wagner Graduate School of Public Service
Concentration: International Development, Management and Leadership, Public Policy Analysis, Finance and Quantitative Analysis, Nonprofit Management and Policy
Description: NYU Wagner's two-year Master of Public Administration (MPA) degree prepares students for public service leadership positions in government, nonprofit, and for-profit organizations worldwide. Through our rigorous curriculum, students develop critical analytical, management, and leadership skills necessary to address complex social problems. The program emphasizes practical application, allowing students to learn from leading faculty and practitioners, and to gain hands-on experience through internships and capstone projects. Graduates are equipped to drive change, manage programs, and analyze policy across various sectors dedicated to the public good.
Accredidation: Fully accredited by the Network of Schools of Public Policy, Affairs, and Administration (NASPAA), the global accreditor of public service education programs.
ScholarshipAmount: Varies, up to full tuition (approx. $98,505 for 45 credits)

Requirements: Online Application, Application Fee, Academic Transcripts, Official GRE Score Report (See below for waiver eligibility), Resume/Curriculum Vitae, Statement of Purpose, Letters of Recommendation, English Language Test (International applicants only).
Department: NYU School of Global Public Health
Concentration: ['Biostatistics', 'Community Health Science and Practice', 'Environmental Public Health Sciences', 'Epidemiology', 'Global Health', 'Health Policy and Management', 'Public Health Nutrition', 'Social and Behavioral Sciences', 'Customized MPH (for current NYU graduate students only)', 'Veterinary Public Health (joint with Cummings School of Veterinary Medicine at Tufts University)']
Description: The NYU Master of Public Health (MPH) is a 42-credit practice-based degree program that prepares students to become leaders in public health. Our students are educated to address local, national, and global health challenges by identifying and analyzing health problems, applying evidence-based approaches to design and evaluate interventions, and advocating for policies that promote health equity and social justice. The curriculum emphasizes critical thinking, interdisciplinary collaboration, and effective communication, equipping graduates with the skills necessary to make a meaningful impact on the health and well-being of diverse populations.
Accredidation: fully accredited by the Council on Education for Public Health (CEPH)

ProgramName: Master of Fine Arts in Master of Fine Arts
Description: The Master of Fine Arts (MFA) in Studio Art program provides an intensive course of study in studio art through the development of professional artistic practice combined with critical research and engagement with contemporary art issues and theory. The program encourages diverse approaches to art-making that challenge disciplinary boundaries, providing opportunities to pursue a broad range of contemporary practices and research topics across art, design, and new media. The Department of Art provides an expansive, interdisciplinary environment that fosters experimentation and innovation within a challenging and supportive atmosphere. Students work closely with faculty mentors, developing strong independent studio practices, and engaging in critical dialogue with peers, faculty, and visiting artists. Students generally select one or two primary areas of focus during their studies. These areas are: Ceramics, Drawing, Painting, Photography, Print Media, Sculpture, and Transmedia (Art and Technology). The three-year program includes 60 credit hours of graduate course work, including graduate seminars, studio courses, and two required teaching assistantships. Students must also complete an MFA thesis project and exhibition.

Requirements: To be considered for admission, applicants must hold a Bachelor of Science degree in nursing from an accredited college or university. In addition, the following application materials are required: Complete the online application; Pay the non-refundable application fee; Official transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended; Three letters of recommendation, one of which must be from an academic source if you have been enrolled in a program within the last five years. These should attest to your clinical competence, academic ability, and potential for leadership. Referees will receive an email from NursingCAS with instructions on how to submit letters on your behalf; A current resume or curriculum vitae (CV); A personal statement (500 words maximum) outlining your professional goals and reasons for pursuing graduate study in your chosen specialization; A copy of your current, active, and unencumbered RN license(s) from the state(s) in which you plan to complete your clinical hours. You will be asked to upload this information as part of your NursingCAS application.
Department: NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing
Description: At NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing, our Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) program is designed to provide registered nurses with the advanced knowledge and skills necessary to excel in a wide range of specialized practice areas. As a leading institution in nursing education, we are committed to preparing the next generation of nurse leaders, clinicians, and educators to address complex healthcare challenges and improve patient outcomes. Choosing NYU Meyers for your MSN means joining a community dedicated to innovation, research, and compassionate care. Our program offers: Specialized Advanced Practice Areas (diverse concentrations such as Adult-Gerontology, Psychiatric-Mental Health, Pediatric Primary Care, Nurse-Midwifery, Women’s Health, Nursing Administration, and Nursing Education); Expert Faculty (nationally recognized leaders in nursing who bring extensive clinical experience and research expertise to the classroom); Cutting-Edge Curriculum (engage with evidence-based practices, advanced clinical skills, and theoretical frameworks that prepare you for leadership roles); Flexible Learning Options (explore full-time and part-time study options designed to accommodate your professional and personal commitments); Clinical Excellence (gain hands-on experience in top healthcare settings across New York City, working with diverse patient populations and interprofessional teams); Career Advancement (position yourself for advanced roles in healthcare, including nurse practitioner, nurse-midwife, administrator, or educator).
Accredidation: The Master of Science in Nursing program at New York University Rory Meyers College of Nursing is accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE), 655 K Street, NW, Suite 750, Washington, DC 20001, 202-887-6791.

Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science
Concentration: Clinical Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Social-Cultural Psychology
Description:
The Doctor of Philosophy in Psychology program is a research-oriented program designed to train future psychologists for careers in research and academe. Graduates of the program are expected to make significant contributions to the field of psychology in terms of research, theory building, and application.
The PhD in Clinical Psychology prepares students for the practice of clinical psychology and for leadership roles in mental health service delivery, research, and policy formulation. Students are trained in assessment, diagnosis, and psychotherapy within the scientist-practitioner model.
The PhD in Developmental Psychology focuses on advanced scholarship and research in the scientific study of human development across the lifespan. It emphasizes developmental processes within their socio-cultural context, particularly in the Philippine setting.
The PhD in Social-Cultural Psychology focuses on advanced scholarship and research in social and cultural aspects of human behavior. It emphasizes the dynamic interplay of individual, social, and cultural factors in shaping psychological processes and outcomes, particularly in the Philippine setting.
ScholarshipAmount: $79,455/Year (total value of funding package including tuition, health insurance, and stipend, based on 2022-23 stipend and 2024-25 tuition/health rates)

Requirements: Applicants for the Doctor of Education (EdD) degree submit their application directly to the Graduate School of Arts and Science (GSAS) and follow their application procedures. Required documents include: Online Application Form, Application Fee, Academic Transcripts, 3 Letters of Recommendation, Statement of Purpose (typically 1-2 pages, single-spaced), Resumé or Curriculum Vitae (CV). The GRE General Test is not required for applicants to GSAS master's and doctoral programs for the 2024–2025 application cycle. If you have taken the GRE General Test and would like to submit your scores, you may do so. English Language Proficiency Exams are required for international applicants from non-English speaking countries unless exempt.
Department: NYU Steinhardt School of Culture, Education, and Human Development
Description: The Doctor of Education (EdD) in Educational Leadership and Policy Studies prepares students for leadership roles in various educational settings, including K–12 schools, higher education institutions, and non-profit organizations. This program emphasizes a critical approach to understanding and addressing complex issues in education through rigorous research, policy analysis, and practical application. Students develop advanced skills in leadership theory, organizational change, policy development, and data-driven decision-making. The curriculum is designed to foster innovative leaders who can drive equitable and effective educational outcomes.

Department: Steinhardt School of Culture, Education, and Human Development
Description: Our PhD in Counseling Psychology prepares students to become leading researchers, university faculty, and practitioners dedicated to promoting social justice and human rights, especially for marginalized populations. We emphasize an understanding of the individual within family, community, and cultural contexts, and the importance of ecological and systemic approaches to intervention, prevention, and training. The PhD in Counseling Psychology is an APA-accredited program designed to prepare students for careers as counseling psychologists in academic, research, and applied settings. Our program is committed to a scientist-practitioner model of training, emphasizing the integration of scientific inquiry and clinical practice. We prepare students to conduct research that contributes to the scientific understanding of human behavior and to apply evidence-based interventions in diverse contexts. The program provides comprehensive training in psychological assessment, diagnosis, intervention, consultation, and supervision, with a strong emphasis on cultural competence and social justice. Students develop expertise in various theoretical orientations, research methodologies, and professional ethics. Through coursework, practicum experiences, and dissertation research, students cultivate the skills necessary for ethical and effective practice and for advancing the field of counseling psychology.
Accredidation: APA-accredited program
ScholarshipPercentage: 100% for tuition (for up to 12 credits/semester) for most PhD students

Requirements: Applicants for the JD program must hold a bachelor's degree from an approved college or university by the time of matriculation. Official transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended are required. Applicants must submit either an LSAT score or a GRE score. Letters of recommendation and a personal statement are also required. Additionally, applicants must register with the Law School Admission Council (LSAC) Credential Assembly Service (CAS).
Description: At NYU Law, we believe the best way to teach you to think like a lawyer is to teach you to think critically about the law—about its history, theory, and purpose, and how it is practiced. This is an education that goes beyond mere training; it challenges you to ask questions, question answers, and learn how to shape the law, not just practice it. Our innovative curriculum and extensive offerings, combined with a supportive community and location in the legal capital of the world, provide an unparalleled legal education and an exceptional foundation for your career.
Accredidation: Approved by the Council of the Section of Legal Education and Admissions to the Bar of the American Bar Association.

Requirements: Admission to the DNP program requires a Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) degree (for the Advanced Practice DNP track) or a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) degree (for the Post-Baccalaureate DNP track) from an accredited institution, a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0, and a current unencumbered registered professional nurse license in New York State (or their current state of practice if outside of NY). Required application documents include: an online application with an $85 fee, Resume/CV, Statement of Purpose (500-750 words), three (3) professional Letters of Recommendation (one from a supervisor/manager), Official Transcripts from all post-secondary institutions, completion of NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing Prerequisite Courses (for Post-Baccalaureate DNP track only), TOEFL/IELTS scores (if applicable), and participation in interviews (by invitation only).
Department: NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing
Concentration: Post-BS DNP Pathways: Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner; Adult-Gerontology Primary Care Nurse Practitioner; Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner; Pediatric Primary Care Nurse Practitioner; Family Nurse Practitioner; Nurse-Midwifery; Dual Nurse-Midwifery/Women's Health Nurse Practitioner. Post-Master's DNP Pathways: Advanced Practice Leadership; Nursing Administration; Nursing Education.
Description: The Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP) is a practice-focused doctoral degree designed to prepare advanced practice nurses to lead healthcare organizations and systems. The DNP curriculum is grounded in nursing science and emphasizes evidence-based practice, leadership, health policy, and information technology. Graduates are prepared to translate research into practice, lead quality improvement initiatives, and develop innovative healthcare delivery models. The DNP program prepares students for the highest level of nursing practice and provides the knowledge and skills necessary to improve patient outcomes and transform healthcare. Through a rigorous curriculum and extensive clinical experiences, students develop expertise in areas such as advanced health assessment, pathophysiology, pharmacology, data analysis, and program evaluation. The program emphasizes interprofessional collaboration and ethical leadership to address complex healthcare challenges.
Accredidation: The Doctor of Nursing Practice program at New York University Rory Meyers College of Nursing is accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE), 655 K Street NW, Suite 750, Washington, DC 20001, 202-887-6791.

Description: The NYU Stern Master of Science in Accounting (MSA) program is a specialized one-year graduate program designed for ambitious students seeking to launch a career in accounting and meet the 150-hour educational requirement for CPA licensure. Our rigorous curriculum provides a deep dive into financial reporting, auditing, taxation, and advanced data analytics, preparing graduates for diverse roles in public accounting firms, corporations, and government agencies. Students benefit from Stern’s prime location in New York City, unparalleled career development resources, and a strong alumni network. The program emphasizes critical thinking, ethical reasoning, and professional communication skills essential for leadership in the evolving accounting profession.
Accredidation: NYU Stern School of Business is accredited by AACSB International (The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business).

ProgramName: Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner Certificate
Requirements: Students applying to the Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner Advanced Certificate program must meet the general requirements for admission to graduate study at the Rory Meyers College of Nursing and hold a master’s or doctoral degree in nursing from an accredited college or university. They must also submit the following: An official transcript from each post-secondary school attended; A current New York State Registered Professional Nurse license and registration; Proof of certification as a Nurse Practitioner in at least one population focus; A curriculum vitae or résumé detailing all clinical experience and education; A personal statement (3–5 pages) describing the applicant’s professional goals, area of clinical interest, and reasons for pursuing the Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner Advanced Certificate; Three letters of recommendation—at least one from an academic professional and one from a supervisor in a clinical setting; International applicants whose native language is not English must also submit results of the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) or International English Language Testing System (IELTS) exam. For additional information, please see the International Admissions section of this bulletin.

ProgramName: Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner MSN
Requirements: Applicants to the Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) program must meet the following minimum requirements: BS with a major in nursing from an accredited program; Minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.0; Current, active, unencumbered license as a Registered Professional Nurse (RN) in the United States. (Applicants must hold an active, unencumbered RN license in the state where clinical experiences will be completed.); Prerequisite: Undergraduate statistics course (3 credits) with a grade of B or higher.; Prerequisite: Undergraduate health assessment course (3 credits) with a grade of B or higher. (If not taken as part of a BSN program, students may enroll in DNPS-GE 2002 Health Assessment for Advanced Nursing Practice, prior to enrolling in their first clinical course.). Required Application Materials: Online Application; Application Fee; Statement of Purpose; Resume/CV; Official Transcripts from all post-secondary institutions attended; Two (2) Letters of Recommendation (at least one must be academic or professional; letters from family/friends are not accepted); Verification of RN licensure; Proof of English Language Proficiency (for international students).
Department: NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing
Description: The Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner (AGACNP) program prepares students to provide direct care to adult and geriatric patients in acute care settings through advanced didactic and clinical coursework. The AGACNP specializes in providing care for patients with complex, acute, and chronic health conditions, ranging from young adults to the elderly. Students are prepared to provide care in various acute care settings, including emergency departments, intensive care units, hospitalist services, and specialty practices. Upon completion of the program, graduates are eligible to sit for the Adult-Gerontology Acute Care Nurse Practitioner certification examination offered by the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC) or the American Association of Critical-Care Nurses (AACN).
Accredidation: The master’s degree program in nursing at NYU Rory Meyers College of Nursing is accredited by the Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (http://www.ccneaccreditation.org).

ProgramName: Master of Science in Biochemistry and Molecular Biology
Requirements: Applicants must complete the online application, submit the application fee, academic transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a statement of academic purpose, and a resume/curriculum vitae (CV). An English Language Proficiency Test is required if applicable. The GRE General Test is not required for admission to GSAS. GRE Subject Tests are not required for this program. A writing sample is not required for this program.
Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science
Graduate School of Arts and Science

ProgramName: Biochemistry and Molecular Biology Executive PhD Online
Requirements: The online application will ask you for a variety of information regarding your academic background, test scores, research experience, and interests. It will also ask you to upload the following documents: Unofficial transcripts from each post-secondary institution you have attended. At least two letters of recommendation (maximum four) through the online application system. A Statement of Academic Purpose describing your academic and research experience, interest in the proposed field of study at NYU, and career goals. A Resume or Curriculum Vitae (CV) including academic background, work experience, volunteer work, research, publications, presentations, and any other relevant experiences. GRE Scores (if applicable; many GSAS departments and programs do not require the GRE; some programs do require or recommend it; consult program's website for specifics). Writing Sample (if applicable; some departments and programs require a writing sample; consult program's website for specifics).

All applicants must submit the following materials through the online application system unless otherwise noted. Each component must be complete and accurate before submission. Applicants are responsible for ensuring the completion and timely submission of all application materials, including those submitted by third parties. The online application is generally available in September for programs beginning the following academic year. Required materials include: Transcripts, Resume/CV, Statement of Purpose, and Letters of Recommendation. GRE scores and Writing Samples are not required for the Biology MS program.
Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science
Description: The Master of Science (MS) in Biology offers students the opportunity to advance their knowledge and skills in various fields of modern biology. The program provides a broad foundation in fundamental biological principles and offers opportunities for specialization through coursework and research. It is designed for students interested in pursuing further graduate studies (including Ph.D. programs), careers in research, biotechnology, health-related fields, environmental science, or education. The program offers both a thesis and non-thesis option. Students in the thesis option complete original research under the guidance of a faculty mentor, culminating in a written thesis and oral defense. The non-thesis option requires a broader range of coursework and can culminate in a capstone project or comprehensive examination. Both options emphasize critical thinking, scientific communication, and advanced laboratory skills, preparing students for diverse professional paths in biology.

The Biology PhD Program is a highly interdisciplinary program that emphasizes student research in cutting-edge areas of modern biology. We attract outstanding students from around the world and provide them with both state-of-the-art facilities and a vibrant, collaborative research environment. Students in the program receive tuition remission and a competitive stipend. Our students come from diverse backgrounds and go on to careers in academia, industry, and teaching. Many alumni have gone on to careers as professors at leading universities, researchers at biotech and pharmaceutical companies, and leaders in science communication.

Requirements: Completed online application, including: Personal Statement, Resume, Letters of Recommendation, Transcripts (from all colleges/universities attended), TOEFL/IELTS scores (international students only), GRE scores (optional but recommended for all applicants), English Language Testing (for non-native English speakers only).
Description: The M.S. in Biomedical Engineering (MSBE) program at NYU Tandon School of Engineering is designed for those who wish to pursue a deeper understanding and specialization in the rapidly growing field of biomedical engineering. This program provides students with a strong foundation in core biomedical engineering principles, along with opportunities to specialize in various sub-disciplines such as biomechanics, biomaterials, medical imaging, neural engineering, and computational biomedical engineering. Graduates are prepared for careers in research and development, academia, and industry within the healthcare and biotechnology sectors. The curriculum emphasizes both theoretical knowledge and practical skills through coursework, laboratory experiences, and thesis or project options. Students will learn to apply engineering principles to solve complex problems in biology and medicine, contributing to advancements in diagnostics, therapeutics, and healthcare technologies.

Requirements: This checklist outlines the documents you'll need to submit to complete your application for all graduate programs: Online Application, Transcripts (from all post-secondary institutions attended), Resume/Curriculum Vitae, Statement of Purpose, Letters of Recommendation (3 required), GRE Test Scores (The GRE is optional for the Biomedical Engineering PhD program for Spring 2024 and Fall 2024), English Language Proficiency (International applicants only), Application Fee.
Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science and Tandon School of Engineering

Description: Our PhD program is designed for students seeking to contribute original research to the field of biomedical engineering. Through a combination of advanced coursework, rigorous research, and mentorship from leading faculty, students are prepared to become independent researchers and innovators. The program emphasizes interdisciplinary approaches, leveraging NYU's strengths in engineering, medicine, and the sciences to address complex challenges in health and disease.
AverageScholarshipAmount: $40,000/Year (Stipend component of full funding package for new PhD students)

ProgramName: Biomedical Engineering MSBE with emphasis in Medical Physics
Requirements: All applicants are required to submit the following materials with their application: Online Application, Application Fee, Resume/Curriculum Vitae (CV), Statement of Purpose, Three Letters of Recommendation, Official Transcripts from all post-secondary institutions, GRE General Test Scores (required for all MS programs except listed exceptions, which does not include Biomedical Engineering MS), and English Language Proficiency Exam scores (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo) if applicable.
Description: The Master of Science in Biomedical Engineering (MSBE) with a specialization in Medical Physics is a 30-credit, CAMPEP-accredited program offered in collaboration with the NYU Grossman School of Medicine. Our curriculum educates students in the fundamental physics of medical imaging and radiation therapy while training them to use the latest technologies and research to develop innovative solutions for global health and medical challenges. Rooted in applied physics, mathematics, chemistry, and biology, medical physics uses an engineering approach to address challenges in medicine and human health. Our graduates are prepared for careers in industry, research, and academia. The program can be completed in two years of full-time study, or students can elect to pursue the degree part-time. Our graduates are well-prepared for entry into residency programs in therapeutic medical physics, diagnostic medical physics, nuclear medical physics, or careers in industry. The program is specifically designed to meet the academic requirements for certification in Medical Physics by the American Board of Radiology (ABR).
Accredidation: CAMPEP-accredited program

ProgramName: Biomedical Engineering PhD with emphasis in Medical Physics
Requirements: Required documents for PhD applicants include: Online Application, Application Fee, Official academic transcripts from all post-secondary institutions, Three letters of recommendation from faculty or supervisors, a Statement of Purpose, and a Resume/CV. The GRE General Test is optional for all PhD and MS applicants for Spring 2024 and Fall 2024 admissions. Applicants for doctoral programs usually possess a master’s degree in engineering or a related discipline prior to admission. However, highly qualified applicants with a bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field may be considered for direct admission to a PhD program. Students applying to PhD programs for Biomedical Engineering (BME) or Chemical & Biomolecular Engineering (CBE) are encouraged to contact specific faculty members in their area of research interest to discuss potential research opportunities prior to submitting their application. English Language Proficiency test scores may be required for international applicants.
Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science (GSAS)
Description: The Medical Physics PhD Track is a specialization within the Biomedical Engineering PhD Program offered at NYU Tandon School of Engineering. This interdisciplinary PhD track is designed for students interested in pursuing research and a career in medical physics. Our program emphasizes rigorous training in the fundamental principles and clinical applications of medical physics, preparing students to excel in academic, clinical, and industrial settings. Our curriculum offers a unique blend of engineering, physics, and medical coursework, providing students with a comprehensive understanding of imaging, radiation therapy, and related technologies. Students conduct research under the mentorship of faculty from the Department of Radiation Oncology and other departments within NYU Langone Health, as well as faculty from the NYU Tandon School of Engineering. Upon graduation, students are well-prepared for careers as medical physicists in hospitals, research institutions, and industry, or for postdoctoral fellowships leading to academic positions. Graduates are also qualified to pursue residency training in medical physics, which is a requirement for certification by the American Board of Radiology (ABR).
Accredidation: CAMPEP-accredited (Commission on Accreditation of Medical Physics Educational Programs)

ProgramName: Master of Science in Biomedical Sciences
Description: Our MS in Biomedical Informatics program, offered through NYU Langone Health, is designed for those seeking to gain expertise in the field of biomedical informatics, whether for a career as a practicing informaticist or to apply informatics principles to their primary field. Our program is highly selective and provides comprehensive training in biomedical informatics, including clinical informatics, translational bioinformatics, and public health informatics. Students learn through a competency-based curriculum, which integrates formal coursework, journal clubs, research rotations, a capstone project, and seminars with leaders in the field. Our mission is to prepare future leaders in biomedical informatics to meet the needs of an increasingly data-intensive medical and public health environment. Our graduates gain the knowledge, skills, and professional attitudes to: understand the key concepts in biomedical informatics and how they apply across its subdomains; identify and apply appropriate methodologies and tools to address biomedical informatics problems; develop, evaluate, and implement innovative biomedical informatics solutions; communicate effectively with diverse audiences, including clinicians, researchers, and public health professionals; practice ethical and responsible biomedical informatics.

Requirements: The NYU Vilcek Institute of Biomedical Sciences requires applicants to submit an online application that includes the following: Statement of purpose (required), Transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate institutions attended, Letters of recommendation (three required), Resume/CV (required), GRE scores (not required), Application fee. International applicants must also submit official TOEFL or IELTS scores unless they meet specific exemption criteria.
Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science
Description:
The Vilcek Institute of Biomedical Sciences at NYU Langone Health is home to a world-class PhD program that prepares the next generation of scientific leaders for careers in basic, translational, and clinical research. Our mission is to provide students with a rigorous and innovative education in biomedical sciences, fostering critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and a deep understanding of biological processes relevant to human health and disease.
The PhD program offers a comprehensive curriculum designed to provide a strong foundation in core biomedical disciplines, including molecular biology, cell biology, genetics, biochemistry, neuroscience, immunology, pharmacology, and computational biology. Students engage in cutting-edge research through laboratory rotations, gaining hands-on experience and identifying their research interests. Throughout their studies, students benefit from close mentorship by our distinguished faculty, who are leaders in their respective fields. We emphasize interdisciplinary collaboration and encourage students to explore diverse research areas within the institute and across NYU Langone Health. Upon completion of the program, graduates are well-equipped to pursue successful careers in academia, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, government, and other scientific enterprises.

Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science
Description: The MS in Biostatistics provides rigorous training in statistical theory and methods for the design and analysis of studies in public health, medicine, and biology. The program focuses on quantitative aspects of designing and analyzing studies, including randomized trials, cohort studies, and case-control studies. Students will learn state-of-the-art biostatistical methods for analyzing various types of data encountered in health sciences. Graduates will be able to perform statistical analysis of data, collaborate effectively with scientists in the health fields, prepare oral and written reports, and pursue further graduate studies in biostatistics. The program is designed for students with strong quantitative backgrounds in areas such as mathematics, statistics, computer science, or engineering.

Three letters of recommendation from faculty members or others qualified to evaluate their academic and/or professional abilities are required and must be submitted online by the recommender. A resume or curriculum vitae and a statement of purpose are required. All applicants whose native language is not English are required to take the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL), International English Language Testing System (IELTS), or Duolingo English Test, unless exempt. For the Biostatistics PhD program, the GRE General Test is optional. A writing sample is not required for this program.

Description: The NYU Stern Executive MBA (EMBA) is a general management program for experienced professionals who are ready to take on greater leadership roles and responsibilities. Our EMBA is designed to accelerate your career, providing you with a deeper understanding of business fundamentals and the strategic acumen needed to lead with confidence in a rapidly evolving global landscape. You will learn to think critically, make data-driven decisions, and inspire teams, all while expanding your network with accomplished peers from diverse industries and backgrounds. The EMBA program at NYU Stern is uniquely designed for working professionals who aspire to advance their careers without pausing their professional lives. The curriculum balances core business principles with a flexible approach, allowing you to tailor your learning experience through a wide selection of electives and specializations. Students gain a comprehensive understanding of global business dynamics, financial markets, marketing strategies, leadership development, and operational excellence. The program emphasizes experiential learning, case studies, and real-world applications, preparing graduates to navigate complex business challenges and drive innovation.
Accredidation: Accredited by AACSB International, the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business.

Requirements: The application to the NYU Stern PhD Program is entirely online. The online application will guide you through all required sections including: Application Fee: The application fee for the PhD Program is $90. Transcripts: You will be required to upload academic transcripts from all post-secondary institutions you have attended. Recommendations: Two letters of recommendation are required, preferably from faculty who know you well and can comment on your research aptitude. Resume/CV: Upload a copy of your resume or curriculum vitae through the online application. Statement of Purpose: The Statement of Purpose is an opportunity to introduce yourself and to highlight the unique strengths and experiences you would bring to the NYU Stern PhD Program. Your statement should describe your motivation for pursuing a PhD, academic interests, research experience, and future career goals. Standardized Tests: The NYU Stern PhD Program accepts either the GMAT or the GRE. Please note that the GRE/GMAT requirement may be waived under certain conditions for applicants to the JD/PhD in Law & Economics program or the MS in Data Science / PhD in Business Analytics joint degree program. English Language Proficiency (International Applicants Only): Official TOEFL or IELTS scores are required for most international applicants whose native language is not English.
Description: The Accounting Specialization prepares students for academic careers at leading research universities. Our curriculum integrates knowledge from accounting, economics, and finance with rigorous analytical and empirical training to conduct research on important topics in financial accounting, managerial accounting, and taxation. Students are required to take advanced courses in economics, econometrics, and statistics. We seek highly motivated individuals interested in conducting rigorous research, developing and applying new theoretical and empirical techniques, and teaching at the university level. Our faculty is engaged in a wide range of research in financial reporting, financial contracting, managerial accounting, and taxation. Recent faculty research has appeared in top academic journals, including The Accounting Review, Journal of Accounting Research, Journal of Accounting and Economics, Review of Accounting Studies, Journal of Finance, Journal of Financial Economics, and The American Economic Review. Our PhD students have received numerous awards, including the AAA/Deloitte/J. Michael Cook Doctoral Consortium Fellowship and the PCAOB Fellowship, and have gone on to hold faculty positions at leading universities, including the University of Chicago, Columbia University, Cornell University, Duke University, Harvard University, INSEAD, London Business School, MIT, University of Pennsylvania, Stanford University, University of Texas at Austin, University of Washington, and Yale University.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based institutional fellowship (includes full tuition waiver, stipend, and health insurance)

English Language Proficiency tests (TOEFL/IELTS/PTE Academic) are required for international applicants unless exempted. An application fee is also required.

Description: The PhD Program in Finance at NYU Stern is designed to prepare students for academic careers in finance. It provides a rigorous and comprehensive training in financial economics, emphasizing both theoretical and empirical methods. The program has a strong research orientation, encouraging students to actively engage in research from the earliest stages of their doctoral studies. Students work closely with Stern’s finance faculty, who are leading scholars in various fields of finance, including corporate finance, asset pricing, behavioral finance, financial econometrics, market microstructure, and FinTech. Graduates of the program are placed in top academic institutions and research organizations worldwide.
ScholarshipAmount: Full tuition waiver (approx. $41,544/year) and student health insurance (approx. $5,040/year), plus a competitive stipend.

Online Application: All applicants must submit their application online through the GSAS Application for Admission.

Description: Our PhD students in Management investigate the challenges confronting organizations as well as the individuals and teams within them. Research in the Management area addresses topics such as strategy (how firms achieve and sustain competitive advantage), organizational behavior (how individuals and groups act in organizations), and entrepreneurship (how firms are created, grow, and innovate). The Management group faculty share interests in micro-organizational behavior, macro-organizational theory and strategy, and entrepreneurship. Students specializing in Management are trained in a variety of research methods including field studies, laboratory and field experiments, and archival data analysis. The goal is to develop scholars who generate and disseminate knowledge through theory-driven empirical research and prepare them for careers as professors at leading research universities.

Description: Management is one of eight fields of study in the Stern PhD Program. The Management Department at NYU Stern is committed to conducting and disseminating cutting-edge research in a wide array of topics. Our PhD students have the opportunity to work closely with world-renowned faculty members and contribute to the advancement of knowledge in the field. The Management PhD program aims to train students to become leading scholars in top research universities and institutions. Faculty research interests include entrepreneurship, strategy (corporate, competitive, international), organizational theory, organizational behavior, innovation, social networks, and technology management. Our PhD students conduct research in these areas, often taking an interdisciplinary approach and collaborating with faculty from other departments at Stern and across NYU.

Description: The NYU Stern PhD Program in Marketing prepares students for careers as academics at leading business schools and universities around the world. The program focuses on developing the conceptual and technical skills needed to conduct high-quality research in marketing. It covers a broad range of topics, including consumer behavior, quantitative marketing, and marketing strategy. Stern Marketing PhD students work closely with faculty mentors, drawing on their expertise and guidance to develop a strong research portfolio. Our PhD program provides comprehensive training in marketing that enables students to pursue academic careers at the highest level. Students develop expertise in both methodology and theory, allowing them to make significant contributions to the marketing discipline. Students gain extensive research experience by working closely with Stern Marketing faculty on various projects. The program also provides extensive opportunities for students to present their research at leading conferences and to build their professional networks.

Please be aware that there are no minimum GMAT, GRE, or GPA scores to apply, but we encourage all candidates to submit their strongest scores. Description: At Stern, you can earn your MBA without missing a beat in your career. Our Part-time MBA program allows students to complete their degree at an accelerated two-year pace or a more flexible timeframe (up to six years), while working full-time. Classes meet on weeknights in our state-of-the-art campus in the heart of Greenwich Village in Manhattan. Part-time MBA students take the same courses, with the same faculty, and earn the same degree as Full-time MBA students. The Part-time MBA program provides the flexibility to complete your MBA degree while continuing to advance in your career. There is no separate application for the Accelerated Two-Year Path. Your pace can be adjusted at any point during your studies. You will earn the same MBA degree as full-time students.
Accredidation: NYU Stern School of Business is accredited by AACSB International – The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business.

ProgramName: Business Administration Accelerated MBA in Real Estate
Requirements: To apply to Stern’s Part-time MBA program, all applicants must submit the following materials: Application Form, Two essays are required, and one optional essay is available. We accept the GMAT, Executive Assessment (EA), or GRE for admission. Please select the exam you plan to take when starting your application. A one-page resume is required. You are required to submit one letter of recommendation. We strongly encourage you to submit one professional recommendation from a current or former supervisor. Official transcripts are required from all undergraduate and graduate institutions you have attended. A $250 non-refundable application fee is required. If English is not your native language, you must submit official results of the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) or International English Language Testing System (IELTS) unless you have completed a bachelor's or master's degree from an institution where the sole language of instruction is English. The minimum TOEFL score for admission is 100 on the iBT (internet-based test) and the minimum IELTS score for admission is 7.0. Interviews are by invitation only, after the application has been submitted and reviewed.
Description: Stern's Part-time MBA in Manhattan offers an Accelerated Two-Year Option, allowing students to earn their MBA in two academic years. You can complete your MBA faster by opting for the Accelerated Two-Year Option. This allows students to take up to 24 credits (8 courses) per semester, for a total of 48 credits over two academic years. You can take a variety of courses within our over 20 specializations, as well as take electives from outside Stern. To take advantage of the accelerated option, students must complete at least 24 credits by the end of their first year. The Accelerated Two-Year Option is available to students in all of Stern’s Part-time MBA programs (Manhattan, Washington Square, and Online).

ProgramName: Business Administration Executive MBA in Health Management and Policy
Requirements: To apply to NYU Stern’s Executive MBA program, you will need to complete the online application and submit the required documents. Required documents include Essays (three short essays, plus an optional essay), a Professional Resume/CV, Unofficial transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate institutions attended, One letter of recommendation from a current or former supervisor, and payment of the Application Fee. The Executive Assessment (EA), GMAT, or GRE is typically required for admission; however, if you have significant and relevant work experience, you may be eligible for a test waiver. An interview is by invitation only. Official TOEFL, IELTS, or PTE Academic score reports are required of all applicants who did not complete their undergraduate degree at an institution where the sole language of instruction was English.
Description: The Healthcare specialization is designed to prepare students for leadership roles within the dynamic global healthcare industry. Students gain a deep understanding of the unique challenges and opportunities in healthcare through courses that cover a wide range of topics, including healthcare economics, policy, operations, and strategy. This specialization provides the analytical tools and strategic frameworks necessary to navigate the complex landscape of healthcare organizations, from hospitals and pharmaceutical companies to health tech startups and government agencies. Graduates are equipped to drive innovation, improve patient outcomes, and contribute to the evolution of healthcare delivery and management globally.

Description: The Global Executive MBA program is an executive-level general management degree designed for high-potential, experienced professionals who seek to enhance their leadership skills, expand their global perspective, and drive innovation within their organizations. The curriculum emphasizes strategic thinking, cross-cultural collaboration, and data-driven decision-making, preparing graduates to navigate complex global business challenges and lead with impact. Through a blend of rigorous coursework, immersive global experiences, and peer learning, students develop a holistic understanding of global business environments and cultivate the competencies necessary to lead effectively in diverse organizational settings.

Offered on a part-time basis over one year, students are trained in the latest data science techniques and learn to apply them in real-world business contexts. Graduates gain the skills to analyze complex business data, build predictive and prescriptive models, and use evidence-based insights to solve complex challenges across a variety of industries. The program uniquely combines Stern’s expertise in business education with cutting-edge data science techniques, preparing students to drive strategic impact in data-driven organizations.

This cutting-edge master's degree empowers professionals to lead at the intersection of business strategy and technological innovation. Our comprehensive curriculum covers essential domains such as data science foundations, cybersecurity best practices, AI and machine learning applications in business, digital product management, and strategic IT leadership. Designed for ambitious individuals from diverse backgrounds, the program hones your analytical acumen and decision-making capabilities, preparing you for influential roles in technology consulting, data strategy, digital transformation, and more. Benefit from Stern's world-renowned faculty and a dynamic global network, all delivered through a flexible online format. Elevate your career with a degree that defines the future of business.

Description: The Molecular Oncology & Tumor Immunology (MOTI) PhD Training Program focuses on providing comprehensive training in the cellular and molecular mechanisms of cancer and anti-tumor immunity. Our program is a part of the Vilcek Institute of Graduate Biomedical Sciences at NYU Langone Health. Research in MOTI includes topics such as molecular pathogenesis of cancer; oncogenes and tumor suppressors; tumor microenvironment; tumor metabolism; epigenetics of cancer; genomic instability; DNA damage and repair; cancer stem cells; metastasis; cancer prevention and early detection; tumor immunology; immunotherapy; cellular therapies; virology and infectious diseases related to cancer. These research areas encompass basic and translational approaches aimed at understanding the biology of cancer and developing novel therapeutic interventions against the disease. Students in the MOTI program learn to critically evaluate scientific literature, design and perform experiments, and effectively communicate scientific findings. Our goal is to train future leaders in cancer research, equipped with the knowledge and skills necessary to make significant contributions to the field.

Prior research experience is strongly encouraged. The Ph.D. program in Chemistry at NYU is designed to train independent, innovative researchers and educators in the chemical sciences. Students pursue advanced coursework, engage in cutting-edge laboratory research under the guidance of faculty, and actively participate in seminars and scientific conferences. The curriculum provides a comprehensive understanding of core chemical principles across various sub-disciplines including analytical, inorganic, organic, physical, and biological chemistry. Graduates are well-prepared for leadership roles in academia, industrial research and development, and government agencies.

Description: The Master of Music in Choral Conducting program at NYU Steinhardt is designed for talented and experienced musicians who intend to pursue advanced careers in choral music in a variety of settings, from churches and schools to professional ensembles. Our program focuses on fostering students' individual growth through a comprehensive curriculum of coursework, practical experience, and a thesis project or professional performance project. You'll work closely with renowned faculty, gaining in-depth knowledge of conducting techniques, rehearsal strategies, vocal pedagogy, and choral literature.

Coursework is delivered one weekend per month with additional online sessions, allowing participants to continue their careers while pursuing their degree.

It covers topics such as project planning and control, construction methods and technology, legal and contractual aspects, risk management, and sustainability in construction. Upon completing the Certificate, you will have a deeper understanding of key concepts in corporate finance and be able to implement them to create value for your organization.

Requirements: Online Application, Application Fee, Official Transcripts from each college or university attended, Resume/CV, Statement of Purpose (a one-page approximately 500 words describing academic and professional qualifications and goals for graduate study), Two (2) Letters of Recommendation (three preferred for doctoral applicants), GRE General Test (optional for all master’s programs for Fall 2024, Spring 2025, Fall 2025, Spring 2026), and English Language Proficiency Requirement (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo) for international applicants whose native language is not English and who have not received a bachelor’s or master’s degree from an institution where the sole language of instruction is English.
Description:
Materials science and engineering is an interdisciplinary field built on the basic sciences of physics, chemistry and mathematics, as well as the engineering sciences. It focuses on the fundamental relationships between the processing, structure, properties and performance of materials, and encompasses all classes of materials, including metals, ceramics, polymers, semiconductors, composites and biomaterials. The Materials Engineering MS program at NYU Tandon School of Engineering offers a comprehensive curriculum that integrates the various facets of materials science and engineering and provides students with a strong foundation in both the fundamentals and practical applications of the field.

The program is designed to prepare students for careers in research and development, manufacturing, and technical management in a wide range of industries, including aerospace, automotive, electronics, energy, biomedical, and advanced manufacturing. Graduates will be equipped to tackle complex challenges related to material selection, design, processing, characterization, and failure analysis.

Students will gain expertise in:
*   Material Characterization: Understanding and applying various experimental techniques to analyze the structure, composition, and properties of materials.
*   Mechanical Behavior of Materials: Investigating the response of materials to external forces, including elasticity, plasticity, fracture, and fatigue.
*   Thermodynamics and Kinetics of Materials: Applying principles of thermodynamics and kinetics to understand phase transformations, diffusion, and reaction processes in materials.
*   Materials Processing: Learning about different manufacturing processes used to produce materials with desired properties, such as solidification, powder metallurgy, thin-film deposition, and additive manufacturing.
*   Computational Materials Science: Utilizing computational tools and simulations to predict material behavior and design new materials.
*   Advanced Materials: Exploring emerging materials such as nanomaterials, smart materials, and biomaterials, and their applications.

The curriculum is flexible, allowing students to tailor their studies to their specific interests through a selection of elective courses. Research opportunities with faculty are also available, providing students with hands-on experience in cutting-edge materials research.

Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science
Description: The M.S. in Mathematics is designed for students who desire a deeper understanding of mathematics and its applications beyond the bachelor’s degree, but who do not plan to pursue doctoral studies. The program provides the mathematical background for a variety of careers in industry, government, or education. It can also serve as preparation for students wishing to pursue doctoral studies in fields related to applied mathematics such as computer science, statistics, or operations research.

Requirements: Applicants are generally required to submit unofficial transcripts from each college or university attended, a Statement of Purpose, three Letters of Recommendation, GRE General Test scores (no waivers), and an application fee. English Language Proficiency scores (TOEFL/IELTS) are required for applicants whose native language is not English and who did not receive a bachelor’s or master’s degree from an institution where the sole language of instruction is English.
Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science
Fees: $22,631/Semester (for 9 points, excluding health insurance, based on 2024-2025 rates)
Fees.1: $82,044 for the program (total tuition component for 36 points, based on 2024-2025 rates)
Description: The M.S. in Mathematics is a two-year degree for students with an undergraduate mathematics background. We offer two tracks: a pure and applied mathematics track and a track in mathematics with a specialization in data science. Students can choose between a standard MS or an MS with thesis. The first year of the program is spent building a solid foundation in core mathematics courses. The second year focuses on advanced topics and research, culminating in either a comprehensive exam or a thesis defense. Our faculty are leaders in their fields, committed to providing a rigorous and supportive learning environment. Students benefit from access to cutting-edge research opportunities, seminars, and collaborations across various departments and institutes within NYU. Graduates of our program are well-prepared for careers in academia, industry, government, and finance, or for further doctoral studies.

Requirements: Academic Transcripts (unofficial for the application, official required upon admission), three Letters of Recommendation submitted by your recommenders through the online application system, Resume/CV, Statement of Academic Purpose (an essay of approximately 500 words describing your academic and research experience, interests, and objectives), GRE General Test scores are required, GRE Subject Test scores are highly recommended, English Language Proficiency Requirement (for international applicants who are not citizens of certain English-speaking countries, did not complete their undergraduate or master’s degree at an institution where the sole language of instruction is English, or who are not applying to specific language programs where English proficiency is inherent to the curriculum).
Department: Graduate School of Arts and Science
Description: Our Ph.D. program in Mathematics prepares students for careers in research and teaching at colleges and universities, and for research positions in industry and government. Students may specialize in pure or applied mathematics. The program provides broad and deep training in the fundamental areas of mathematics. Our doctoral students acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to contribute to mathematical research and scholarship. The Department of Mathematics, within the Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences, is one of the top-ranked mathematics graduate programs in the world. Many of its faculty members are leaders in their fields, and a number of its graduates have gone on to distinguished careers. The Department is especially well-known for its strengths in applied mathematics and analysis, and its excellent faculty in algebra, geometry, logic, number theory, and probability. Students in the Ph.D. program choose a specific area of concentration for their thesis research, and they may choose to fulfill some requirements in an interdisciplinary manner. Students are expected to complete the program in five years.

Concentration: General Mechanical Engineering; Mechatronics and Robotics
Description: The Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (MAE) at NYU Tandon School of Engineering offers a Master of Science (MS) in Mechanical Engineering that will provide you with a comprehensive understanding of the theory and principles of mechanical engineering. Our rigorous curriculum emphasizes both fundamentals and cutting-edge topics in areas such as robotics, smart materials, fluid mechanics, renewable energy, and sustainable design. Graduates are prepared for leadership roles in industry, government, and academia, or for further doctoral studies.

Requirements: Applicants to all GSAS programs are required to submit an online application form, transcripts, three letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose, and a resume/curriculum vitae. The GRE General Test is optional for all applicants for all programs in GSAS. A writing sample is not required for the Mechanical Engineering PhD program. International applicants must also submit English Language Proficiency examination scores (TOEFL/IELTS/PTE) unless exempt.
Description: The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Mechanical Engineering is granted in recognition of the candidate's mastery of the theory and practice of mechanical engineering, and their ability to conduct advanced, original research. The goal of the program is to educate future academic, government, and industrial leaders in mechanical engineering by training students in fundamental and applied topics, as well as providing opportunities to conduct cutting-edge research. The program emphasizes the interdisciplinary nature of mechanical engineering and its growing role in areas such as biotechnology, nanotechnology, and sustainable energy. The core curriculum ensures that students have a strong foundation in mechanical engineering principles, while a wide range of elective courses and research opportunities allow students to tailor their studies to their specific interests.
ScholarshipAmount: Full tuition waiver, health insurance, and a living stipend of $38,000/year (2024-25)
ScholarshipType: Full Funding (Tuition Waiver, Stipend, Health Insurance)

ProgramName: Master of Science in Media Management
Requirements: Transcripts from all colleges and universities attended, Letters of Recommendation, Personal Statement, Resume/CV, GRE General Test Scores (optional), English Language Testing (if applicable).
Description: Our MA curriculum is focused on the critical study of media and communication through an interdisciplinary lens grounded in social science, humanities, and critical theory. We are dedicated to exploring media, culture, and communication in global and historical contexts, and we emphasize the social, cultural, political, and economic dimensions of media in the United States and around the world. Our students acquire the skills necessary for rigorous critical analysis and research in media and cultural studies. Our curriculum emphasizes the acquisition of critical and methodological skills that prepare students for either further academic study or employment in a variety of industries and organizations concerned with understanding the social meaning and impact of media. Students take foundational courses in media theory and research methods, then select from a wide array of specialized courses addressing topics such as digital media, global media, media industries, critical race and media studies, communication and technology, gender and media, and media history. The program culminates in either a thesis or an extended research project.
